description: Type the HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION Contact Center AI Insights returns for QA scorecard revision/question writes that race the scorecard's revision state. It surfaced as a generic BadRequest, so callers matched on the message.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The scorecard revision is not in a state that allows this change (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION 'Precondition check failed.'), e.g. a new revision while the current one is still being created. Retryable briefly.
